limits.disk: Cartesian estimate plus boundary directory-byte observations; not an OS quota
limits.duration: boundary-only; native calls and retirement are not preempted
limits.memory: Cartesian estimate plus sampled process Go heap; not a hard RSS limit

timing_semantics.cache: OS cache neither flushed nor isolated; warmup performed after ordinary close/reopen
timing_semantics.elapsed_seconds: entry through normal resource finalization, including data generation, checks and reopen; report serialization excluded
timing_semantics.index_build_ms: Begin, native index construction and successful Commit; checks/reopen excluded
timing_semantics.insert_ms: Begin, all inserts, boundary checks and successful Commit; table creation excluded
timing_semantics.percentiles: sorted observed index floor((N-1)*p); no interpolation
timing_semantics.query_ms: single native Tx.VectorSearch call only; Begin, Rollback, correctness checks, timing storage and boundary guards excluded
timing_semantics.query_order: K ascending 1/10/100; query ordinal ascending; exact first on even zero-based ordinal; one shared read transaction per pair
timing_semantics.warmup: one exact and one ANN call per K in separate explicit read transactions; not timed

notes: Synthetic independent standard-normal float32 vectors; held-out queries follow rows on the same pinned Go math/rand stream. GSV hashes exclude metadata exactly as historical ANN reports.
Source ID is an operator-supplied exact frozen tree/manifest digest; verify it against the executed build outside this process. Build settings are observed independently.

Hardware ID is an operator-supplied controlled host label; observed CPU, affinity and memory/container limits are separately hashed. Shared hardware timings are descriptive, without confidence intervals or speedup claims.
Persistent native index is built, checked, normally closed, reopened without creation, and its data and index are verified before timed queries. No all-graph memory preload.
Ordinary plaintext DELETE-journal workload only. No concurrent workload, crash, interruption of publication, recovery, corruption, injected failure or durability acceptance test.
Boundary guards and native algorithm/pager quotas bound admitted work but do not provide a hard wall-clock, RSS or disk guarantee. Every raw database and report is retained; no automatic deletion.

All publicly acquired DB/Tx/Rows are tracked; every failure preserves its original joined diagnostic. Any uncertain retirement permanently forbids passed status. Internal engine resources are covered only by their public joined errors.

Recall is overlap with exact top-K including deterministic rowid tie order. HNSW default recall@10 >= 0.95 is an evaluation target, not a pass guarantee. Native paths and exact fallbacks are counted separately.
